paper_title: Generating Diverse Training Samples for Relation Extraction with Large   Language Models
caption: Average cosine similarity between generated training samples (K=32) for each relation category.

model_annotations.Bulgarian: Тази линейна диаграма илюстрира средната косинусова подобност между генерирани тренировъчни примери (K=32) за всяка категория на връзка, като сравнява три различни подхода: „w/o DPO obo“, „w/o DPO obo & w/o div-hint“ и „DPO“, както и техните съответни средни стойности, представени с пунктирни линии. Оста X, означена като „Relation Category“, представлява дискретен набор от категории на връзки, номерирани от 0 до около 65, с равномерно разпределени етикети през интервали от 10. Оста Y, означена като „Mean Interclass Similarity“, е линейна и обхваща диапазона от 0.0 до 0.5, с етикети на всеки 0.1. Три основни линии с маркери са представени: синята линия („w/o DPO obo“) с плътна линия и кръгли маркери, оранжевата („w/o DPO obo & w/o div-hint“) с плътна линия и квадратни маркери, и зелената („DPO“) с плътна линия и триъгълни маркери. Средните стойности са показани с пунктирни линии в съответния цвят и са маркирани с числови стойности: 0.158 за „w/o DPO obo“, 0.107 за „w/o DPO obo & w/o div-hint“ и 0.086 за „DPO“. Всички три основни линии показват значителна вариация по оста X, с върхове, достигащи до 0.48 (синя линия при категория 32) и спадове до 0.03 (оранжева линия при категория 50). Средните стойности са хоризонтални линии, които визуално подчертават, че методът „DPO“ има най-ниска средна подобност, следван от „w/o DPO obo & w/o div-hint“, а „w/o DPO obo“ — най-висока.
model_annotations.English: This line plot illustrates the mean interclass similarity, measured as average cosine similarity, between generated training samples (with K=32) across 64 distinct relation categories, as presented in the paper “Generating Diverse Training Samples for Relation Extraction with Large Language Models.” The x-axis, labeled “Relation Category,” spans integer values from 0 to 64, representing individual relation categories, with tick marks at intervals of 10. The y-axis, labeled “Mean Interclass Similarity,” ranges from 0.0 to 0.5, with major gridlines at 0.1 intervals. Three primary solid lines represent different experimental conditions: “w/o DPO obo” (blue, circle markers), “w/o DPO obo & w/o div-hint” (orange, square markers), and “DPO” (green, diamond markers). Two dashed lines represent their respective moving averages: “Average of w/o DPO obo” (blue dashed), “Average of w/o DPO obo & w/o div-hint” (orange dashed), and “Average of DPO” (green dashed). The blue line exhibits high variability, peaking sharply at approximately 0.48 around category 32 and dipping to near 0.0 at category 64. The orange line also shows high volatility, with a peak near 0.43 at category 60 and a sharp drop to 0.03 at category 62. The green line remains relatively stable and low, mostly below 0.15, with a peak of about 0.22 at category 27. Horizontal reference lines are drawn at 0.158 (orange dashed), 0.107 (blue dashed), and 0.086 (green dashed), corresponding to the average similarity values for each condition. The plot visually contrasts the higher and more erratic similarity scores of the “w/o DPO” methods against the lower, more consistent scores of the “DPO” method.
model_annotations.German: This line chart displays the mean interclass similarity, measured as the average cosine similarity between generated training samples (with K=32) for each relation category, plotted across 64 distinct relation categories on the x-axis. The x-axis, labeled “Relation Category,” is linearly scaled from 0 to approximately 64, with tick marks appearing at intervals of 10. The y-axis, labeled “Mean Interclass Similarity,” is linearly scaled from 0.0 to 0.5, with major tick marks at 0.1 intervals. Three primary solid lines represent different experimental conditions: a blue line labeled “w/o DPO obo,” an orange line labeled “w/o DPO obo & w/o div-hint,” and a green line labeled “DPO.” Additionally, three dashed lines represent the moving averages of these conditions: a light blue dashed line for “Average of w/o DPO obo,” an orange dashed line for “Average of w/o DPO obo & w/o div-hint,” and a green dashed line for “Average of DPO.” The blue line begins at approximately 0.22 at relation category 0, peaks sharply at 0.49 at category 2, then fluctuates with multiple peaks above 0.25, including a spike near 0.48 at category 32, before declining to near 0.02 at category 64. The orange line starts near 0.08, rises to 0.19 at category 2, and exhibits high volatility with multiple peaks exceeding 0.3, including one near 0.43 at category 32 and another near 0.47 at category 60, before dropping to approximately 0.07 at category 64. The green line begins at 0.19, dips to 0.06 at category 2, and generally remains below 0.2, with a peak near 0.18 at category 32 and a final value of approximately 0.06 at category 64. The dashed average lines remain relatively flat: the blue dashed line is positioned near 0.107, the orange dashed line near 0.158, and the green dashed line near 0.086, indicating the overall mean similarity levels for each condition across all categories.
